text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
 every 8000 equivalent operating hours EOH as indicated in the title block
The air filters filler the air of compressor form dust.
Technical data
Size | 144 Cartridges, 24''24''x12"
Pressure drop | 190 Pa to 650 Pa
Efficiency | 99 %
The first draft initiated by eng. Mostafa Hamza, revised by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator, 
and approved accepted by eng. Hamdy El-Melegy: general 
director of El-Shabab GT.
This document is accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC 
planning 
and financial prediction head sector and supervisor of 
inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks to surround the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs 
 ... etc.
Turbine must be shut down
Complete 
 maintenance tool set
Cleaning 
 fluid ( WD 40 )
Rags
Work to be Carried Out
Loosen the thumb screw, and rotate the latch.
Remove the Renu prefilter frame, don't discard.
Remove the cartridge filter.
Insert clean Duracel with air flow arrows and pleats in the proper orientation.
Install the Renu 
 prefilter frame, rotate the latches into position and tighten the thumb screw.
